rows.text: Set up your AI once. Three guides for $47 together instead of $81 separately: the Claude Operator’s Manual, Standing Orders for Your AI and Your Personal Specialists has ready-made setups for jobs like Sales or Finance. It has 14 Specialists and 231 prompts, and it is sold only in this bundle.
A 217-page PDF, for Claude only, on setting Claude up so every chat starts out knowing your work.
Twenty rules you load once. Each rule switches on or off, and the guides cover ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok.
One infographic, a dated snapshot, of model releases, when each capability arrived, and when companies from each country joined.
A short guide to doing home jobs with the chat app you already use, with the words to paste for each one, such as your internet bill, the week’s dinners and a trip.
